notes: No messages published or consumed by auth application code in the given files (no topic, no consumer group). Kieker monitoring records go to a RabbitMQ queue named 'kieker' (upstream utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.dockerbase/kieker.monitoring.properties:28,32) via ChunkingCollector chunkSize=32 (:33), deferredWriteDelay=500 (:34), taskRunInterval=20 (:36); recorded as telemetry, not as application messaging.

Writer selection: kieker.monitoring.properties:40 defaults to FileWriter; start.sh:33-36 switches to ChunkingCollector/AMQP when RABBITMQ_HOST != unset; compose sets RABBITMQ_HOST: "rabbitmq" for auth (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:79).

Trace export: Tracing.init (upstream utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/registryclient/tracing/Tracing.java:42) builds a JaegerTracer with ConstSampler(true) and no reporter or sender configured; the Jaeger reporter destination and flush interval are library default, not in these files. No metrics or log shipper is configured in these files.
Registry failure timeout and cleanup interval are not stated in the given files (registry service files not provided): library default / not in these files.

Calls to persistence (all via LoadBalancedCRUDOperations, load-balanced REST/JSON): AuthCartRest.java:60 (getEntity products), AuthUserActionsRest.java:96 (orders), :106 (orderitems), :137 (users). Auth also calls the registry over HTTP: RegistryClient.java:244-245 (PUT register/heartbeat), :264-265 (DELETE unregister), :193-195 (GET server list).
Registry client polling: LoadBalancerUpdaterDaemon scheduled every LOAD_BALANCER_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS = 2500 ms, initial delay 1000 ms (RegistryClient.java:64,161-162).

Health: auth exposes GET ready/isready returning true (ReadyRest.java:27,38-40) but the compose block for auth (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:72-83) has no healthcheck key and the auth Dockerfile (services/tools.descartes.teastore.auth/Dockerfile:1-4) has no HEALTHCHECK; the base image Dockerfile was also read and has none.
Replica count is not stated (no deploy.replicas in docker-compose_kieker.yaml:72-83); Compose default applies.

AMQP connection heartbeat requested by Kieker is overridden by the compose command to KIEKER_AMQP_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS=900 (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:19,80,28); this is a Kieker-to-RabbitMQ connection heartbeat, not the registry heartbeat.

replicas.note: library default, not in these files: the auth service block (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:72-83) sets no deploy.replicas; Compose runs one container per service by default.

registersWith.note: registry host from REGISTRY_HOST: "registry" (harness docker-compose_kieker.yaml:78); registry URL placeholder in web.xml:31 registryURL.
